brief: Two small hands reaching out of two opened drawers: one cutting a thread with tiny scissors, the other holding a little scale; the Vetāla leaning back with a pleased look; Dādī reciting; Dhātuka ticking his ledger.
A circle of small spirits with hands cupped to their ears around the Vetāla who is also listening, head tilted; Śuka hopping; Dādī smiling; Dhātuka ticking his ledger; firelight.

The fifteenth statue: two stone figures standing back to back on one plinth, one holding a lotus, the other a bow; Śuka reading the long carved name on the plinth; Dādī with her hand on the stone; Lubdhaka's foreman copying it down.

The eighteenth statue holding a clay pot, tapping it with one finger; a potter's wheel carved at her feet; Śuka cocking his head; Lubdhaka's foreman holding up his notebook to show a column of compounds.
